question_text: In Barangay San Isidro, a dispute arises between neighbors over a property boundary. The Punong Barangay calls both parties to a meeting under the Katarungang Pambarangay system. Which of the following best describes the role of the Punong Barangay in this process?

options.text: He acts as a judge who issues a binding decision that the parties must follow.
He serves as a mediator or conciliator to help the parties reach an amicable settlement.
He refers the case directly to the Municipal Trial Court for formal adjudication.
He appoints a panel of elders to decide the dispute without the parties' input.
